 app_roles ||--o{ app_user_roles : granted
 app_users ||--|| app_user_attributes : owns

 app_users {
 uuid id PK
 text sub UK \"OIDC subject\"
 text email UK
 text username UK
 text full_name
 bool is_active
 }

 app_roles {
 uuid id PK
 text name UK
 text description
 }

 app_user_roles {
 uuid user_id FK
 uuid role_id FK
 timestamptz granted_at
 }

 app_user_attributes {
 uuid user_id PK,FK
 text department
 text employee_id UK
 text location
 jsonb extras
 }",
 "config": null
